description: Phase 1: SqlFs IFileSystem backed by Postgres — types, dialect, caching, all read/write methods. 42 stories across 8 epics.

userStories.title: SqlDialect interface definition
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the SqlDialect interface defined so that dialect implementations have a clear contract to fulfill.
acceptanceCriteria: SqlDialect interface exported from src/fs/sql-fs/types.ts with JSDoc on each method
Connection: connect(), disconnect()
Transactions: transaction<T>(fn: (tx) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>
Context: setSandboxContext(tx, sandboxId: string): Promise<void>
Sandbox lifecycle: createSandbox(tx, sandboxId) returns { rootInodeId }, deleteSandbox(tx, sandboxId)
Inode CRUD: createInode(tx, opts) returns id, getInode(tx, id) returns InodeRow|null, updateInode(tx, id, updates), deleteInode(tx, id)
Nlink: incrementNlink(tx, id), decrementNlink(tx, id) returns new nlink value
Dirent CRUD: insertDirent, upsertDirent (returns old inodeId|null), deleteDirent (returns removed inodeId), listDirents, moveDirent
Blob ops: upsertBlob(tx, sha256, data), getBlob(tx, sha256) returns Uint8Array|null, gcOrphanBlobs(tx) returns count
Bulk: loadAllPaths(tx) returns PathCacheEntry[], loadSubtreeInodes(tx, rootId) returns bigint[], bulkIngest(tx, files)
Path resolution: resolvePath(tx, path, followLast) returns inodeId
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Shared types for inode, dirent, cache entry
userStories.description: As a developer, I want shared type definitions for database rows and cache entries so that SqlFs and all dialects use consistent shapes.
acceptanceCriteria: InodeRow type: { id: bigint, sandboxId: string, kind: 1|2|3, mode: number, size: number, mtime: Date, nlink: number, contentSha256: Uint8Array|null, symlinkTarget: string|null }
DirentRow type: { parentInodeId: bigint, name: string, inodeId: bigint }
PathCacheEntry type: { inodeId: bigint, kind: 1|2|3, mode: number, size: number, mtime: Date, contentSha256: Uint8Array|null, symlinkTarget: string|null }
Transaction generic type that each dialect can specialize
StorageBackend union type: 'postgres' | 'mysql' | 'azure-sql' | 'azure-fileshare' | 'memory'
All types exported from src/fs/sql-fs/types.ts
Typecheck passes

Each constructor returns Error with code property (e.g. 'ENOENT') matching just-bash convention

sanitizeFsError(err) strips connection strings, host paths, and internal table names from error messages

userStories.title: Postgres dialect — fs_resolve stored procedure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a plpgsql stored procedure that resolves a path string to an inode ID with symlink handling.
acceptanceCriteria: fs_resolve(p_path TEXT, p_follow_last BOOLEAN) plpgsql function in src/fs/sql-fs/migrations/postgres/0001_rls_and_procs.sql
Walks path components left-to-right looking up each in dirents
Follows symlinks on intermediate components always; follows last component only when p_follow_last = true
Handles '.' (skip) and '..' (parent) components
Depth counter capped at 40 (raises SQLSTATE 'FS001' = ELOOP)

Uses current_setting('app.sandbox_id') to find sandbox root
